subject: GCP private offer: proposed MAP, eval cadence, and billing path
messages:
From: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@solstice.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer: initial ask + target close window

Hannah / Ben —

Thanks for the demo yesterday — product looked good and the runtime numbers lined up with what our infra team expects. We want to move this to a quick evaluation + procurement path. High-level ask: can Redwood provide a short mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to procurement checkpoints for a GCP private offer? Key constraints from our side:

- Target contract start: 2028-06-01 (we want production workload by early June).
- Procurement window: we need 2 internal approvals (Security + Cloud ops) by 5/15 to get PO issued to our finance team.
- Billing preference: routing via GCP private offer (we need clear steps for invoice & billing owner).

Would appreciate a one-page MAP + a brief checklist of the docs your procurement/legal team will need (SOC2 evidence, Sample PO language, DPA/Privacy). If you can include the expected timing for a private-offer activation and whether Redwood needs a signed DocuSign before GCP billing is active, that would be helpful.

Also copying procurement@solstice.com — please loop in the right folks if I'm missing anyone.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of Product
Solstice Systems
[Attachment: internal-risk-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@solstice.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: initial ask + target close window

Tom —

Great to hear — glad the demo lined up with your latency targets. I put together a compact MAP & procurement checklist and attached a draft (GCP-MAP-v1.xlsx). Below is the short version we recommend for a 6-week cadence to hit 2028-06-01 production.

Mutual Action Plan (short):
- Week 0 (now — 4/27): Evaluate / smoke test — Solstice runs a 1-week perf/e2e test with our test tokens + Redwood provides a prioritized prompt set.
  - Owner: Solstice (tests) / Redwood (support + loading guide)
- Deliverables: perf report by 4/28; sample billing & PO language by 4/29.

- Week 1 (4/28 — 5/6): Legal & Security review. Redwood to share SOC2 summary, DPA, and required security evidence. Solstice to surface redlines.
  - Owner: Solstice legal & SecOps / Redwood legal 
- Deliverables: redline list and SOC2 packet by 5/6.

- Week 2 (5/7 — 5/15): Commercial alignment & PO prep. Agree final price/commit and billing path (GCP private offer flow).
  - Owner: Solstice procurement / Redwood sales + finance
- Deliverables: Signed PO or purchase confirmation to Redwood finance by 5/15; confirm private-offer activation window.

- Week 3 (5/16 — 5/26): Private-offer activation & technical on-ramp. Redwood coordinates GCP private-offer creation; Solstice accepts offer in GCP console.
  - Owner: Redwood ops / Solstice cloud ops
- Deliverables: Offer accepted in console; initial invoice schedule set.

- Week 4 (5/27 — 6/1): Production cutover. Final checks, KV cache warm-up, traffic shift; go-live on 6/1.

Billing path notes (short):
- For GCP private offer: Solstice accepts the private offer in GCP Marketplace; GCP will reflect the commitment on Solstice's billing. Redwood issues an invoice for usage or reserved capacity per the private-offer terms (we can invoice either to Solstice or coordinate reseller flow if you prefer reseller billing).
- If Solstice prefers GCP-to-customer invoicing only, we can work with your finance team to align on invoice recipient and timing.

Attachments included: GCP-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone dates), SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (SOC2 evidence summary), private-offer-terms-diff.docx (template language + redline-friendly copy).

Next steps: Can you confirm the two names on your Security & Cloud Ops review and whether procurement can commit to target PO by 5/15? We can turn the MAP into a shared Google Sheet (I can push once you confirm contacts).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: GCP-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: private-offer-terms-diff.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@solstice.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: initial ask + target close window

Tom —

Quick note from finance/ops side: if Solstice wants Redwood to invoice directly post-acceptance (common path), we'll need the PO and billing contact (name + email + billing address) no later than 5/15 to align our billing cycle and to guarantee the 6/1 start. If you'd prefer to have GCP handle the full billing (GCP invoices Solstice) then we only need confirmation that the private-offer acceptance has completed; in that case our internal invoice will be routed as reconciliation rather than primary billing.

Also: if there are any required adjustments to payment terms (net30 vs net45) or invoice recipients, flag them now so we can draft the final invoice template.

I'll stand by to create the invoice template and help with DocuSign flow once legal signals green.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: procurement@solstice.com
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@solstice.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: initial ask + target close window

Hannah / Ben —

Thanks for the MAP — it's helpful and aligns with our internal cadence. Confirming the following from procurement/security: 

- Security reviewer: Mira Patel (mira.patel@solstice.com). Target to complete review by 5/6.
- Cloud ops: Jorge Alvarez (jorge.alvarez@solstice.com). He will handle the private-offer acceptance in the GCP console.
- Procurement will aim to issue the PO by 5/15 if we get the final redlines by 5/6.

Two clarifying questions: 
1) SOC2 packet: the SOC2-summary-2027.pdf looks good; can you provide the full SOC2 snapshot or a link to the secure evidence bundle? Security wants access to the raw controls matrix.
2) DocuSign: we typically need a counter-signed MSA before accepting a private offer. Can Redwood prepare the final MSA with the commercial terms from the MAP and send via DocuSign? We can counter-sign quickly once the redlines are addressed.

Also, procurement attached a small format PO template we use for marketplace purchases (PO-Solstice-Template.pdf) — please use it for the invoice template.

Next steps we expect:
- Redwood: supply SOC2 evidence bundle link + updated MSA for DocuSign by 5/6.
- Solstice: complete Security review by 5/6, procurement issues PO by 5/15.

If you can drop the DocuSign link in this thread, I'll make sure legal gets the notification.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Solstice Systems
[Attachment: PO-Solstice-Template.pdf (pdf)]
